gold: Inflammation-induced ocular neuropathy associated with SARS-CoV-2–induced panuveitis

selector.rationale: Optic Neuritis best explains the relative afferent pupil defect, central scotoma, impaired color and contrast vision, and noticeable pupillary edema without contradiction

rejected.label: Viral retinitis
rejected.why: lack of strong viral serology evidence

rejected.label: Retinal Vasculitis
rejected.why: less comprehensive evidence compared to Optic Neuritis

rejected.label: SARS-CoV-2 infection
rejected.why: while positive for SARS-CoV-2, the ocular findings are more specifically explained by Optic Neuritis
